title: SPERA: Spherical Prior EEG Foundation Model with Geometry- and Frequency-Aware Latent Prediction
content:
arXiv:2610.10571v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides a non-invasive measure of ongoing neural activity, but building general-purpose EEG models remains challenging due to the heterogeneity of subjects, devices, and electrode montages. Existing EEG foundation models predominantly rely on reconstruction-based objectives defined on the observed signal, which contains both neural and non-neural components. We introduce SPERA (Spherical Prior EEG Representation Architecture), an EEG foundation model that adopts the joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to predict in latent space. SPERA introduces a Legendre-polynomial spatial prior, incorporated into attention to encode varying scalp electrode geometries. Two further components adapt the model to EEG: factorized temporal and spatial attention interleaved with periodic full-attention blocks, and a relational spectral regularizer aligning latent similarity structure with spectral views. title: fix: pin and bound Hookify rule reads
content:
fix: pin and bound Hookify rule reads

Open with supported no-follow and nonblocking flags before relying on file metadata. Validate descriptor, pathname and rule-directory consistency before and after reading at most64KiB plus one overflow byte. Reject observed replacement, mutation, premature EOF and non-regular files, and close descriptors on every outcome.

Add12 race and I/O regressions. Keep the Hermes uppercase protected-file fixture real on case-sensitive filesystems and verify that the installed guard still permits first-time creation.

Validation: full6688 reported tests across347 files,12 race tests, full80% coverage gates, scoped Hookify coverage, installed Hookify and Hermes workflows, packed artifact lifecycle, lint, signatures and IOC.
author: haelyra
summary_zh: everything-claude-code 仓库的一次安全修复提交：给 Hookify 读取规则文件的流程加了防护。读取时用 no-follow 和非阻塞方式打开文件，最多读 64KiB，并在读取前后检查文件描述符、路径和规则目录是否一致，用来防止文件被替换、篡改等竞态攻击。同时新增了 12 个竞态和 I/O 回归测试，并确认安装后的防护仍然允许首次创建文件。

title: Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
content: Using GPT-6 Astra in Codex, Asana made its browser agent 76x cheaper and 5x faster in tests to offer customers more capable models.
summary_zh: Asana 在 Codex 中使用 GPT-6 系列模型，优化浏览器测试中的 agent，测试成本降低 76 倍，速度提升 5 倍，因此能为客户提供能力更强的模型。这是一个 AI 编程工具落地到浏览器自动化测试的企业案例，可用于评估模型选型和 agent 成本。不过原文只有简短摘要，没有具体实现细节，标题和正文里的模型名称也不一致（GPT-6.1 Sol 和 GPT-6 Astra）。
